title: Progressives Launch ‘Ready for AOC’ Ahead of 2028 Presidential Election
summary: A new political organization aims to encourage Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to run for president, and to demonstrate that a formidable organizing apparatus is awaiting her.
